description.zh: 待执行命令的实例ID。N的范围：1~10。
description.en: The instance ID of the instance on which to execute the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
待发送文件所在的OSS Bucket。

> 首次导入apk文件到该OSSBucket前，请添加RAM授权策略，否则会报错NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount。
description.en:
The OSS bucket where the file to be sent is stored.

> Before importing an APK file to the OSS bucket for the first time, add a RAM authorization policy. Otherwise, the NoSetRoletoECSServiceAcount error is returned.

description.zh: 文件所在的OSS Object的文件名称（key）。
description.en: The name (key) of the OSS object where the file is stored.

description.zh: 拉取文件所在云手机中的完整路径
description.en: The full path of the file on the cloud phone.

title.en: Push a file to a cloud phone
